description: This file defines traits and classes for calculating impurity measures and information gain in Spark's MLlib, specifically for decision tree algorithms. It includes interfaces for impurity calculation, aggregation, and specific implementations for impurity metrics like Gini, Entropy, and Variance.

classes.name: Impurity
classes.description: Trait for calculating information gain, used for setting impurity parameters and computing impurity values from statistics.

classes.name: ImpurityAggregator
classes.description: Abstract class for updating views of sufficient statistics to compute impurity from samples.

classes.name: ImpurityCalculator
classes.description: Abstract class for storing statistics for impurity calculation of a specific (node, feature, bin).

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merge statistics from one bin into another.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update statistics for a (node, feature, bin) with a label.

methods.name: getCalculator
methods.description: Retrieve an ImpurityCalculator for a (node, feature, bin).

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Create a deep copy of the ImpurityCalculator.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Add another ImpurityCalculator's statistics into this one.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtract another ImpurityCalculator's statistics from this one.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Get the weighted number of data points in the statistics.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Get the prediction based on the statistics.

methods.name: prob
methods.description: Get the probability of a label, or -1 if unavailable.
